Item: Throttle position sensor, Kia, 3-pin Mazda-style plug
Notes: Manual cars: not in the total; Also sold as 0K24718911, 0K30A18911 or aftermarket TH291 / 5S5504 / TPS4185 (rusEFI wiki list). Plugs into the car's stock throttle switch plug: 1N gives it 5 V (fit R28), 2D is its ground, 2L its signal (move R29 to R30). Before fitting R28, check with an ohmmeter which sensor pins are the track ends (constant resistance between them at any throttle) and that they meet the 1N and 2D wires; the third pin, the wiper, must meet 2L.
